summary: Windows 1.0.66 (two attempts): COM7 answered PROGRAMCOLOR with 'P' (echoed command, so not the programming cable); COM6 read ~75 68-byte blocks, then one R request got no reply and the read failed. OEM CPS v1.0.7 resends an unanswered block request every 1 s up to five more times; stock CHIRP aborts on the first timeout.
title: Read stops when the radio misses one block reply; stock aborts instead of re-requesting
